subject: Re: Walkthrough slot deferred — resource lock & FY budget latch
messages:
From: Jordana Li <jordana.li@appbridge.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@appbridge.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Walkthrough planning — potential conflict with CFO travel & FY freeze
Attachments: q4_priorities.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Quick heads-up — our CFO will be traveling for an extended customer roadshow the week of Nov 9–16 and Procurement has flagged a temporary spending freeze until the FY refresh is finalized. Given that, we need to push the full product walkthrough we had penciled in.

Our priority is to avoid losing momentum but also not to waste exec time during the travel window. Two asks from my side:
- Can we split the demo into a short exec briefing (high-level outcomes + cost/ROI) and a separate technical deep-dive for the engineering team?
- If we split, can you propose tentative slots for after Nov 16 (CFO back) and a fallback week (Nov 30 onwards)?

Procurement copied me here with a short note on PO timing — they expect decisions to align with the FY budget reset. I've attached our Q4 priorities so you can see how this maps to the reforecast.

Appreciate any quick availability you can propose; we want to keep the deal active but aligned to internal windows.

Thanks,
Jordana Li
Sr. Product Operations
AppBridge Technologies
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordana Li <jordana.li@appbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Walkthrough planning — potential conflict with CFO travel & FY freeze
Attachments: calendar_snapshot.png (image/png)

Jordana — thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the Q4 priorities. Totally understand the need to align with procurement and the CFO calendar.

I like your split approach — it keeps exec alignment without delaying technical progress. Quick proposal from our side to keep things moving:
1) 30-min exec briefing (decision-oriented): Tue Nov 17 or Wed Nov 18, 11:00–11:30 PT
2) 60–90 min technical deep-dive / pilot prep: Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:30 PT

If those windows won't work for your team, we can also push both into the week of Nov 30. I've attached a snapshot of the slots we're tentatively holding on our side.

Rishi, looping you in to confirm availability for the technical run-through and to flag any pre-demo artifacts we'd want from AppBridge (sample prompts, traffic profile, SLAs).

Next steps:
- Jordana / procurement: confirm which of the two windows (Nov 17/18 + Nov 19 or week of Nov 30) you'd prefer to hold tentatively.
- We'll prepare a short mutual action plan and estimated pilot terms to get Procurement comfortable with a conditional PO path.

Best,
Markus Klein
Principal Account Executive — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: procurement@appbridge.com
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordana Li <jordana.li@appbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Walkthrough planning — procurement timing note

Markus / Kimberly — procurement here. Short note to confirm: our PO queue will remain gated until the FY budget refresh (expected week of Nov 23). That said, we can commit to an exec briefing prior to the refresh to scope requirements and a conditional pilot agreement that can be finalized after the PO clears.

Request from our side:
- Please provide a concise mutual action plan that outlines milestones, decision points, and what triggers a PO commitment.
- Include pilot pricing and an option for a short trial (30 days) so we can evaluate performance ahead of full approval.

HubSpot reference: AB-4732.

Thanks,
AppBridge Procurement
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordana Li <jordana.li@appbridge.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Walkthrough planning — resource lock & FY budget latch (proposed split sessions)
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (application/pdf), calendar_snapshot.png (image/png)

Jordana — thanks for coordinating and procurement for the clarity. We can split the engagement as you requested and hold tentative slots while Procurement works the FY refresh.

Proposed, tentative schedule (please confirm):
- Exec briefing (decision-oriented): Wed, Nov 17, 11:00–11:30 PT — 30 min
- Technical deep-dive / pilot prep: Fri, Nov 19, 10:00–11:30 PT — 90 min

What we attached: a short mutual action plan that maps outcomes to decision triggers and a snapshot of the slots we've tentatively held. Highlights:
- Pilot terms: 30-day trial with conditional PO; pricing line-items called out in section 2.
- Decision milestones: exec briefing (confirm scope), tech deep-dive (confirm readiness), Procurement signoff window (target: week of Nov 23–30).
- Contingency: if PO cannot be issued by Nov 30, we will convert the pilot to a short paid POC rate for the evaluation period; we included a discounted interim rate for that case (pending final approval).

Next steps (clear asks):
1) Jordana — confirm that Nov 17 and Nov 19 work for your exec and engineering teams.
2) Procurement — review the attached MAP and confirm which doc-level approvals you need to move the conditional PO forward.
3) Markus / Rishi — we'll draft the short trial agreement and pricing addendum once Jordana confirms slots.

Quoting Jordana's earlier note: "we want to keep the deal active but aligned to internal windows." This split approach preserves momentum while respecting the FY latch.

Thanks — happy to adjust slots if needed.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0274
